reviews.summary: Post-PR-18 hardening, four rounds. Round 1 PASS: the Host rule installed once in onboarding_serve.assemble and measured on a real socket under both uvicorn parsers (loopback identities 200; every foreign, empty, absent, IPv6, uppercase, look-alike-suffix and trailing-dot Host 400 before any route runs, POSTs included); the only protection removed is the runtime's own copy; probe_instance's Host is admitted; smoke_bundle never produced pass against thirteen hostile listener modes; four P3s applied. Round 2 FAIL: the applied body deadline did not hold on a real socket -- HTTPResponse.read loops receives internally, so a trickling listener held _get open past its budget -- and its pinning test used a fake reader; the builder replaced the design with a _Budget watchdog that shuts the socket down at the end of one budget per exchange, pinned by a real loopback trickling listener. Round 3 PASS, finding 2 closed: body trickle 1 B / 2 s ended in 6.02 s as the budget TimeoutError (also with Connection: close and chunked), stall 5.00 s, silent 5.01 s, header trickle 5.03 s, whole body intact; through smoke_bundle a trickling /api/runtime gave result fail naming the observation with no scratch left; two LOW notes: the shutdown does not wake a receive already pending on Windows (the bound is twice the budget, tighter than the docstring claimed) and a body shorter than its declared Content-Length was accepted as complete. Round 4 (narrow) FAIL: both round-3 dispositions verified exactly as claimed (slow trickles 1.02 s / 6.02 s under 1 s / 5 s budgets, worst shape 1.95 s / 9.92 s, all the budget's TimeoutError; short body IncompleteRead; through the smoke a short page gave result fail naming get /), but the Content-Length guard added for the second note held two new LOW defects -- a parse of our own raised ValueError out of the smoke on a hostile header, and a declared length above the read bound escaped the comparison. Round 5 (narrow) PASS, no findings: F-1 and F-2 closed by live measurement -- a Content-Length of one latin-1 byte and one of 5000 digits each return the body through _get and pass through the smoke with the page judged on its own facts and no ValueError; a 2 MiB declaration with 8 bytes raises IncompleteRead and through the smoke gives result fail naming get /; a 2 MiB declaration with a 1 MiB body returns intact and passes; equal-length and close-delimited bodies intact; the slow trickle ends at 1.03 s; check_security.py pass; 45 and 13 passed. No security finding from any round remains open.
